meta.title: An uninvited vendor cannot open a bid
warnings: act 1: QA vendor 2 is not invited in this setup — it acts as an uninvited vendor

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: A second QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Bid could not be placed. Please refresh and try again.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: An uninvited vendor cannot open a bid

expected.message: Bid could not be placed. Please refresh and try again.
